name: You'll Never Catch Me Leaving
source:
[i]"Do what you will, but in whatever you will, lie. Speak quickly and with moderate confidence. Good liars get caught, great liars never stop. I love you. Never stop."[/i]

"You'll Never Catch Me Leaving" is a short visual novel about a girl who can't stop lying and the impossible creatures haunting her life.

[From [url=https://skyshard.itch.io/youll-never-catch-me-leaving]itch.io[/url]]
